content: ScaDS.AI (Scalable Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence) Dresden/Leipzig is a German research competence center uniting TU Dresden and Leipzig University to advance scalable methods, education, and industry collaboration for analyzing and applying large-scale data and AI.
